scope: Only cnr, the first European missing native acoustic resource; no expansion of the other language gaps

bounded_registry_rechecks.observation: No returned publicly indexed matching TTS model in this name search
Bounded repository search, not proof that no privately held or differently named native model exists

new_primary_leads.publisher: Igor Culafic, Tomo Popovic, Stevan Cakic / University of Donja Gorica
new_primary_leads.license_observation: Zenodo metadata says cc-by-4.0; the record also includes an IEEE personal-use/permission notice. Neither grants an absent checkpoint a redistribution license.
new_primary_leads.observation: A genuine Montenegrin cultural-heritage TTS research paper was located. The public record contains one PDF and no model weights. The abstract compares voice-cloning systems; it does not establish a released standard-cnr acoustic checkpoint.
new_primary_leads.retrieval_limit: IEEE page required JavaScript verification; web PDF opens failed. Conclusions above rely on author/record metadata and the actual file inventory, not an invented full-paper reading.

new_primary_leads.windows_runtime_evidence: Publisher documents local Windows Python 3.12/CUDA inference with a Transformers Higgs port, resident model/reference, and offline local paths. This is upstream implementation evidence, not a test on our Windows/NVDA installation.
new_primary_leads.observation: Useful actual local Windows implementation was found, but no native cnr checkpoint was established: OmniVoice trials explicitly select sr/hr/bs; Higgs comparison has no explicit language parameter. Author leaves native pronunciation and voice identity for listening validation. A conversation_language=cnr text setting is not proof of cnr acoustic training or correct Ś/Ź.
new_primary_leads.license: No root LICENSE/COPYING file was returned by the pinned root inventory. Source reuse needs file-level permission review; Higgs model has a separate restrictive research/noncommercial license.

new_primary_leads.architecture: Approximately 4B autoregressive decoder, Higgs audio codec, 24 kHz output
new_primary_leads.download_bytes_interpretation: One official backbone weight file only, excluding tokenizer/runtime. No installed-size or RAM measurement; no download performed. This file alone exceeds the 3 GB main-installer maximum.
new_primary_leads.license: Boson Higgs TTS 3 Research and Non-Commercial License; product embedding/production/hosted APIs require a separate commercial license according to the primary card. Digital-creator grant does not automatically permit packaging a synthesizer.
new_primary_leads.language_evidence: The primary 102-language WER/CER list includes Serbian, Croatian and Bosnian but does not list Montenegrin. Neither generic multilingual capability nor readable Unicode establishes correct native cnr ś/ź phonemes and prosody.

new_primary_leads.role: Transcript/time-boundary review and export tool, not acoustic TTS weights
new_primary_leads.windows_runtime_evidence: Publisher provides Windows startup/release instructions with Python 3.11/3.12, local faster-whisper and FFmpeg dependencies.
new_primary_leads.unicode_evidence: README explicitly preserves ś, ź and Cyrillic without regional normalization. Sample timing audio is synthetic tones. UTF-8 preservation is a useful preparation property but no proof of pronunciation.
new_primary_leads.license: No root LICENSE/COPYING file was returned in the pinned root inventory; do not copy its source until file-level permission is established.
new_primary_leads.potential_use: Reference for a future human-validated cnr corpus-preparation workflow. Current export is 16 kHz mono and cannot silently replace original lossless/high-sample-rate audio for TTS training.

prior_rejections_preserved: Balkansmedia/tts-ai- and nikolab/speecht5_tts_hr: prior evidence established Croatian training and future Montenegrin collection. Do not retry as if regional project naming proved native cnr.
AlfaNum: prior genuine commercial/local-service lead still has no established downloadable redistributable native weights in our evidence. No demo harvesting or paid contact performed.
SIL-AI mlv-mntnt identifier is not ISO cnr evidence; no download or relabeling.
WorldSpeech cnr_me is a real previously identified ASR-data candidate, not a trained TTS checkpoint. Its source terms, speaker/recording quality and standard Ś/Ź coverage remain unverified.
CLASSLA-web.cnr.2.0 is a previously identified text corpus. It may inform lexical language detection but does not provide acoustic synthesis or pronunciation acceptance.

exact_remaining_blocker.availability: No inspected public primary release establishes a downloadable, appropriately licensed cnr acoustic checkpoint with documented standard Montenegrin distinctions, a compatible local runtime and validated output. Bounded searches cannot prove nonexistence elsewhere.
required_before_integration: A publisher-native cnr release or a separately authorized native training/adaptation project with resolved source terms
Pinned checkpoint, tokenizer/phoneme inventory and runtime dependencies, byte sizes and license
Native listening assessment of Ś/Ź, ijekavian forms, character names, stress and prosody; related-language or ASR tests alone are insufficient
Local Windows/NVDA cancellation, typing, routing and audible latency validation against the unchanged product targets
exact_remaining_blocker.no_silent_scope_expansion: No base-model training budget, paid license or new large GPU runtime was assumed. cnr remains missing; other independent product work can continue.

actions_not_taken: No Serbian/Croatian substitution or hidden fallback registered as cnr
No gated/private model access, paid service calls or contact with publishers
No weight, audio corpus, full repository or large document download
No live NVDA, audio driver, user settings, packages or acceptance-gate changes
